title: Where Do the Three Medians Meet? | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
Why do the three medians of a triangle meet two thirds of the way down each median? Vantee proves it with a half-size copy of the triangle, then finds the segment through that meeting point that is parallel to a side. A second way uses equal areas, every wrong choice is explained, and you get a new triangle to try yourself.
